remarks:
Spacious Amherst home offering over 2,085 square feet of versatile living space! With two bedrooms and a full bath on each level, the flexible floor plan presents a variety of living arrangements, including opportunities for owner-occupants, multi-generational living, or those seeking space near the University at Buffalo.

The main level features a large eat-in kitchen with updated appliances, including a stove and dishwasher replaced in 2025. A bright living room with a picture window flows into the dining area, while an additional central room provides valuable extra space. The first-floor full bath also includes convenient laundry facilities. Washer and dryer are included.

A side entrance provides easy access to the second floor, where you'll find a spacious family room, two generously sized bedrooms, a full bath, and a bonus room ideal for a home office, hobby space, or additional storage.

Situated on a desirable corner lot with easy access from Emerson Drive, this property offers exceptional convenience to shopping, dining, parks, and everyday amenities. The double-wide driveway provides ample off-street parking for multiple vehicles. Additional features include a full basement under most of the home, a deep crawl space beneath a portion of the structure, and a new forced-air furnace installed in 2026.

Conveniently located in the heart of Amherst, close to the University at Buffalo and all the area's amenities, this home combines space, flexibility, and value in a highly desirable location.
